title: Deleting Business Partners
text:
Deleting Business Partners
Deleting Business Partners
Prerequisites
Deleting business partners is only possible if the respective student information has no references to other applications. Please use the reset programs in the following areas:
Sales and Distribution (Customer Master Data)
Purchasing (Vendor Master Data)
Cost Accounting (G/L Account Master Data)
Student Lifecycle Management (Student Master Data)
Activities
If all applications that use business partners have reported that a business partner has no purpose and the residence period is expired, then the system blocks the business partner, preventing access by dialog users and business processes. The write program of business partner archiving writes these business partners to an archive file and deletes them from the database.
If extracts containing the business partner were replicated for valuations in
SAP BW∕4HANA
, the
S/4HANA (ERP)
System can send data protection notifications to the
BW∕4HANA
System so that you can also delete the personal data there (see SAP Notes
2824456
and
2779751
).
Data destruction destroys personal data for a business partner only if the retention period configured in ILM Retention Management has expired.
You can use SAP ILM to delete business partner data from the system after the expiration of a certain, possibly legally specified timeframe.
